mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kcschedule_task_switch_log (task_name, scheduled_name, operation, reason, operator, operate_time) VALUES (#{taskName}, #{scheduledName}, #{operation}, #{reason}, #{operator}, #{operateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_name, scheduled_name, operation, reason, operator, operate_time FROM kcschedule_task_switch_log WHERE task_name = #{taskName} ORDER BY operate_time DESC
